evidence.field: Summary; source; permission; file history; versions
evidence.text: The file page identifies 看-seal.svg as a drawing of 看 in Shuowen seal-script style. It credits source material to Sinica Database, Chinese Etymology, the Multi-function Chinese Character Database, Chinese Text Project, and Chinese Linguipedia, including Sinica image 27.770B and Chinese Etymology image S02484. The page states CC0 1.0 and separately mentions Richard Sears site permission. The SVG path itself was inspected locally at docs/glyphs/wikimedia_seal/看-seal.svg; its visible composition is a figure above an eye-like rectangular figure, consistent with the received 手-over-目 analysis. This verifies the file's content and stated provenance as an illustration, not an independently dated artifact.
evidence.title: File:看-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.source: 漢典 (ZDIC), 看 entry, quoting 說文 and 段玉裁注
evidence.field: 說文解字; 說文解字注; 字源字形
evidence.text: The received Shuowen text gives 睎也。从手下目 and records 𥉏 as an alternate written with 倝; the commentary states 倝聲 and cites Xu Kai's interpretation of shading the eyes with the hand to gaze. This supports the received semantic analysis and a distinct phonetic analysis for the alternate graph. It does not establish dated pre-Qin forms, a corruption sequence, or an artifact chronology.
evidence.title: 看 kàn、kān - 漢典

evidence.source: 漢典 (ZDIC), 看 entry, citing transmitted texts
evidence.text: The dictionary cites 《世說新語·德行》 荀巨伯遠看友人疾 for a ‘visit’ use and 《三國志·周魴傳》 看伺空隙 for watching/keeping observation. It also lists look, reading, estimate, prepare/manage, consider and care-for senses with examples attributed to later works. These citations attest usages in the cited textual traditions, but do not give a complete dated corpus or establish a semantic chronology between the senses.
evidence.title: 看 kàn、kān - 漢典

evidence.source: 漢典 (ZDIC), 看 entry, quoting Kangxi Dictionary and 音韻方言
evidence.field: 反切; 中古音; 唐代讀音; 上古音
evidence.text: The entry reports 苦寒切 for a level-tone reading and 苦旰切 for a departing-tone reading, and displays Tang readings *kɑn and *kɑ̀n. It says both readings have been glossed ‘see’ in older lexicographic tradition; that does not demonstrate that the modern ‘look’ and ‘guard’ senses originated as a pronunciation-conditioned chronological split.
evidence.title: 看 kàn、kān - 漢典

evidence.text: The required official per-character pages for 看 U+770B, 手 U+624B, and 目 U+76EE were attempted and inaccessible through the web tool. The harness-provided local Unihan rows report 看 kàn, 手 shǒu, and 目 mù. These are local dataset observations, not externally verified page contents and not evidence of an ancient phonetic relation.
evidence.title: Unihan Data Lookup: U+770B

evidence.text: The harness-provided local Unihan row reports 手 shǒu. The official character-specific page was attempted but inaccessible. Modern reading only; 手 is treated in the received Shuowen analysis as semantic component, not phonetic.
evidence.title: Unihan Data Lookup: U+624B

evidence.text: The harness-provided local Unihan row reports 目 mù. The official character-specific page was attempted but inaccessible. Modern reading only; 目 is treated in the received Shuowen analysis as semantic component, not phonetic.
evidence.title: Unihan Data Lookup: U+76EE

evidence.source: Local Baxter–Sagart 2014 table supplied in the input packet
evidence.field: sources/baxter-sagart/baxtersagart.tsv exact rows; system Baxter–Sagart 2014; MC and OC are separate columns
evidence.text: Exact local rows: 手 py shǒu, MC syuwX, OC *n̥uʔ; 目 py mù, MC mjuwk, OC *C.m(r)[u]k; 看 py kān, MC khan, OC *kʰˤa[r] (‘to watch, guard’); 看 py kàn, MC khanH, OC *[kʰ]ˤa[r]-s (‘gaze at’). The contrast in the local reconstruction rows does not support either 手 or 目 as the phonetic component of 看. No official browsed upstream character page for this local dataset was verified, so this is recorded as supplied local data rather than an external citation.
evidence.title: Baxter–Sagart local table row observation (upstream page not verified)

evidence.text: ZDIC labels 看 an上下構形會意 graph, gives the received small-seal explanation 手 over 目, and separately lists 𥉏 as a form with 倝 phonetic. Its form catalogue also lists transmitted ancient-script forms without supplying dates in the inspected entry. This is evidence of dictionary catalogue claims, not proof of the dating, identity, or continuous evolution of each form.
evidence.title: 看 kàn、kān - 漢典

search_audit.query: Commons File 看-seal.svg Wikimedia Commons; 看 seal script character 說文 睎也 从手下目 古文字
search_audit.outcome: Search result noise included unrelated files. Opened the exact Commons file page and confirmed its described script style, cited source trail, CC0 statement, file history, and alternate versions. The exact imageinfo API request failed via the web tool; Commons page itself was readable. Chinese Text Project entry fetch returned 403.

search_audit.query: 看-seal.svg S02484 看 小篆 字形来源 Shuowen; 看 甲骨文 J29285 B19532 说文篆书 字源 看
search_audit.outcome: Opened ZDIC’s character-specific entry and inspected its received Shuowen quotation, commentary, examples, readings, and form catalogue. Opened hanziyuan but its dynamic character panel failed to refresh and displayed unrelated default content, so its listed form identifiers were not treated as evidence. Unicode pages failed; Sinica Xiaoxuetang linked character page returned cache miss and its yanbian page returned 401.

gaps: Commons’ page identifies the image as Shuowen seal style and lists a Sinica image as its source, but the linked Sinica character-specific page could not be opened; the exact claimed source image was therefore not independently compared. The image is usable only with a narrow label such as ‘Shuowen seal-style form (digital drawing),’ not as a dated inscription.
No directly inspected, securely dated oracle-bone, bronze, or Warring States form was established. The Commons file's alternate-script links and ZDIC catalogue are leads, not date verification.
The alternate 𥉏 is described in the received Shuowen entry as using 倝 phonetic, but its date and graphic relationship to 看, including any corruption proposal, remain unresolved.
Semantic glosses and transmitted text examples establish several uses but not the earliest occurrence of the spoken word or a dated chain connecting gaze/look, visit, read, consider, tend, and guard.

Official Unihan character-specific readings pages for 看, 手, and 目 were inaccessible. Exact local rows were supplied and checked: kàn, shǒu, mù. Their upstream click-through content could not be verified.

The Baxter–Sagart readings were checked against exact harness-provided local rows, including both 看 readings and each proposed component; no fetched official upstream page for the local TSV was verified. The reconstruction comparison supplies no support for 手 or 目 as phonetic components. No sound role is inferred from modern pronunciations.
No tracked extract recommendation is made: the Commons file itself is a verified individual asset with stated CC0 terms, while bulk reuse terms and a versioned dataset extract were not established.
